She'll then state that position in the snarkiest, most offensive way possible specifically trying to use terms and arguments that will outrage the other side. When they go off on her as an insane whack-job she can then turn around to the half of the electorate which agrees with her and say: "See what those insane whack-jobs think about you and your perfectly reasonable opinions?".She's the political pundit version of an internet troll fishing for outrage.
